learning_outcomes.text: Understand the fundamentals of communications and computer networks for an industrial environment.
Design the most suitable network architecture for the integration of automatic systems.
Design and implement an information system for the storage and exploitation of manufacturing data.

syllabus_topics: Industrial Ethernet and wireless industrial communications
assessment_rules: The exam accounts for 50% of the grade. The work accounts for 50% of the grade. A minimum score of 4.5 out of 10 is required for both the exam and the work to pass the subject.
